# Whitefield Malayali Social Club (WMSC)

> WMSC is a community organization bringing Malayalis in Whitefield and nearby Bengaluru neighbourhoods together through Kerala culture, sport, local support and shared celebrations. Official website: https://wmsc.in/.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://wmsc.in/): About WMSC, community groups, membership and community activities in Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.
- [Onam 1.0](https://wmsc.in/onam/): WMSC's Onam celebration, including cultural programmes, traditional games and Onam sadya. The date and venue are to be announced; check this page for updates.
- [Community news](https://wmsc.in/blog/): Malayalam report published on 4 September 2026 about the WMSC executive committee meeting and preparations for Onam celebrations.

## Community activities

Sports and games; cultural and arts activities; cyber alerts; classifieds and business; runners and joggers; charity and blood donation; riders group; Super Ladies League; and general community conversations.

## Membership and social profile

- [Join WMSC](https://forms.gle/ajbEX18S3ryEoFgC8): Membership form linked from the official website.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/whitefieldmalayalisocialclub): WMSC's linked community profile.

## Source notes

The linked pages are the source of current details. No confirmed Onam date, venue or ticket price is currently published on the Onam page. The site publishes English and Malayalam content. WMSC stands for Whitefield Malayali Social Club.
